description: Summary figure: Srlp active-site geometry, ortholog conservation, crotonase family comparison, model confidence
code:
import requests, os, json
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
H={"User-Agent":"curation-agent/1.0"}; OUT="/tmp/srlp"; os.makedirs(OUT,exist_ok=True)
r=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q9VG69-F1-model_v6.pdb",headers=H,timeout=120)
open(f"{OUT}/AF.pdb","wb").write(r.content)
plddt={}
for l in open(f"{OUT}/AF.pdb"):
    if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA": plddt[int(l[22:26])]=float(l[60:66])
pl=np.array([plddt[i] for i in sorted(plddt)])

# values computed in the preceding cells
cat = pd.DataFrame({
 "position":["Glu144 site\n(catalytic base)","Glu164 site\n(catalytic acid)",
             "Gly141 N\n(oxyanion hole)","Ala98 N\n(oxyanion hole)"],
 "rat ECH (2DUB)":[3.10, 3.46, 2.64, 3.28],          # E144 OE1->C3'; E164 OE2->C3'; G141 N->O1'; A98 N->O1'
 "Srlp (AF model)":[2.85, np.nan, 2.58, 4.05],       # E158 OE2->C3'; no carboxylate; N155 N->O1'; F108 N->O1'
 "rat residue":["Glu144","Glu164","Gly141","Ala98"],
 "Srlp residue":["Glu158","Asn178","Asn155","Phe108"]})
orth = {"F108\nA98 site":{"F":37,"Y":24,"L":4,"N":1},
        "N155\nGly141 site":{"N":30,"G":19,"E":10,"I":4,"V":2,"A":1},
        "E158\nGlu144 site":{"E":62,"D":3,"T":1},
        "N178\nGlu164 site":{"N":48,"C":9,"G":7,"F":1,"S":1}}
panel = pd.DataFrame([
 ("rat ECH 2DUB","Glu144","Glu164",1,1),("rat ECH 1EY3","Glu144","Glu164",1,1),
 ("human ECHS1 2HW5","Glu144","Glu164",1,1),("human AUH 1HZD","Glu189","Glu209",1,1),
 ("rat DCI 1DCI","Asp176","Glu196",1,1),("E. coli PaaF 4FZW","Glu109","Glu129",1,1),
 ("Mtb MenB 1Q51","Ser164","Asp185",0,1),("Pf HCHL 2J5I","Val154","Glu143",0,1),
 ("4-CBA-CoA dehal. 1NZY","Gly117","Trp137",0,0),
 ("Dmel Srlp (AF)","Glu158","Asn178",1,0)],
 columns=["structure","res_144site","res_164site","acid144","acid164"])

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(15.5,10.5))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2,height_ratios=[1,1],hspace=0.42,wspace=0.28)

# A: active-site distances
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
x=np.arange(len(cat)); w=0.36
ax.bar(x-w/2,cat["rat ECH (2DUB)"],w,color="#3b6ea5",label="rat ECH 2DUB (crystal)")
sr=cat["Srlp (AF model)"].values
ax.bar(x+w/2,np.nan_to_num(sr),w,color="#c25a4a",label="Srlp AlphaFold, superposed")
for i,v in enumerate(sr):
    if np.isnan(v): ax.text(i+w/2,0.25,"no carboxylate\nwithin 5 A",ha="center",va="bottom",fontsize=9,color="#c25a4a",fontweight="bold")
for i,v in enumerate(cat["rat ECH (2DUB)"]): ax.text(i-w/2,v+0.08,f"{v:.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=8)
for i,v in enumerate(sr):
    if not np.isnan(v): ax.text(i+w/2,v+0.08,f"{v:.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([f"{p}\n{a} / {b}" for p,a,b in zip(cat.position,cat["rat residue"],cat["Srlp residue"])],fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_ylabel("distance to substrate atom (A)")
ax.set_title("A  Active-site geometry after structural superposition\n(217 CA pairs, RMSD 1.41 A)",loc="left",fontsize=11)
ax.axhline(3.5,ls=":",c="grey",lw=1); ax.text(3.45,3.58,"H-bond limit",fontsize=7.5,c="grey",ha="right")
ax.legend(fontsize=8.5,loc="upper left"); ax.set_ylim(0,5.2)

# B: ortholog conservation
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
cols={"E":"#b03030","D":"#d4705a","N":"#4a7fb5","G":"#8fb7d9","C":"#6a9a5b","Y":"#c9a227","F":"#e0c15a",
      "L":"#999999","I":"#bbbbbb","V":"#cccccc","A":"#dddddd","T":"#aaaaaa","S":"#b5b5b5"}
labels=list(orth); bot=np.zeros(len(labels))
seen=set()
for aa in ["E","D","N","G","C","F","Y","L","I","V","A","T","S"]:
    vals=np.array([orth[k].get(aa,0) for k in labels],float)
    if vals.sum()==0: continue
    ax.bar(labels,vals,bottom=bot,color=cols[aa],edgecolor="white",lw=.6,label=aa)
    for i,(v,b) in enumerate(zip(vals,bot)):
        if v>=4: ax.text(i,b+v/2,f"{aa}{int(v)}",ha="center",va="center",fontsize=8,color="white",fontweight="bold")
    bot+=vals
ax.set_ylabel("number of orthologs (n = 66)")
ax.set_title("B  Residue identity at mapped positions across 58 arthropod\n+ 8 vertebrate Srlp orthologs (OMA)",loc="left",fontsize=11)
ax.tick_params(axis="x",labelsize=8.5)
ax.annotate("acidic in 65/66",xy=(2,66),xytext=(2,73),ha="center",fontsize=9,color="#b03030",fontweight="bold",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#b03030"))
ax.annotate("acidic in 0/66",xy=(3,66),xytext=(3,73),ha="center",fontsize=9,color="#1a1a1a",fontweight="bold",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#1a1a1a"))
ax.set_ylim(0,82); ax.legend(fontsize=7,ncol=7,loc="lower center",frameon=False)

# C: family panel
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
yy=np.arange(len(panel))[::-1]
for i,row in panel.iterrows():
    y=yy[i]
    for j,(flag,res) in enumerate([(row.acid144,row.res_144site),(row.acid164,row.res_164site)]):
        c="#b03030" if flag else "#dcdcdc"
        ax.add_patch(Rectangle((j,y-0.38),0.92,0.76,color=c))
        ax.text(j+0.46,y,res,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=8.5,color="white" if flag else "#333333",fontweight="bold")
ax.set_xlim(-0.05,2); ax.set_ylim(-0.7,len(panel)-0.3)
ax.set_xticks([0.46,1.46]); ax.set_xticklabels(["Glu144 site\n(activates water)","Glu164 site\n(proton donor/shuttle)"],fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(yy); ax.set_yticklabels(panel.structure,fontsize=8.5)
for s in ("top","right","left","bottom"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
ax.tick_params(length=0)
ax.set_title("C  Acidic residue present (red) at each ECH catalytic site,\nacross superposed crotonase-superfamily structures",loc="left",fontsize=11)
ax.get_yticklabels()[-1].set_color("#c25a4a"); ax.get_yticklabels()[-1].set_fontweight("bold")

# D: pLDDT + domains
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
res=np.arange(1,len(pl)+1)
ax.plot(res,pl,lw=1.1,color="#2d5d8a")
ax.fill_between(res,0,pl,color="#2d5d8a",alpha=.12)
ax.axhspan(0,50,color="#d9534f",alpha=.07); ax.axhspan(90,100,color="#5cb85c",alpha=.07)
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((53,4),301-53,7,color="#3b6ea5")); ax.text(177,14,"PF00378 crotonase core 53-301",ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((247,4),297-247,7,color="#7fae3f")); ax.text(272,-6,"trimerisation helices\n247-297",ha="center",fontsize=7.5)
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((1,4),40,7,color="#bbbbbb")); ax.text(20,14,"predicted MTS",ha="center",fontsize=7.5)
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((302,4),378-302,7,color="#bbbbbb")); ax.text(340,14,"charged tail",ha="center",fontsize=7.5)
for p,lab,c in [(158,"E158",'#b03030'),(178,"N178",'#1a1a1a'),(155,"N155",'#4a7fb5')]:
    ax.axvline(p,color=c,lw=1,ls="--",alpha=.8); ax.text(p,103,lab,rotation=90,fontsize=8,color=c,va="bottom",ha="center")
ax.set_xlabel("Srlp residue"); ax.set_ylabel("pLDDT"); ax.set_ylim(-12,118); ax.set_xlim(0,379)
ax.set_title("D  AlphaFold confidence for Srlp (mean pLDDT 81.2;\ncrotonase core 92.9)",loc="left",fontsize=11)
plt.suptitle("Drosophila Srlp (Q9VG69): crotonase fold with the catalytic base retained and the catalytic acid lost",
             fontsize=13.5,y=0.985)
plt.show()
print(cat.to_string(index=False)); print(); print(panel.to_string(index=False))
